name: Conduit Domain Model
description: Model Conduit User, Profile, Article, Comment, Tag, Favorite, and Follow relationships before business logic changes.
triggers: User Profile Article Comment Tag Favorite Follow

verificationSteps: Verify actual model, serializer, API, and frontend DTO names before reporting them.
Distinguish relationship tables or edges from scalar display fields.
Record differences between backend model names and frontend data shapes.

safeDefaults: Treat Favorite and Follow as relationships, not fields on Profile.
Treat unknown comment-like behavior as a relationship or interaction until verified.

successCriteria: Domain understanding object covers User, Profile, Article, Comment, Tag, Favorite, and Follow.
Favorite is not described as Profile like.
Follow is not described as Profile like.
Comment like, if requested, is treated as relationship or idempotent interaction until verified.
